name: Fed + X Brief
tagline: Weekday morning Fed brief plus a call on whether to post, quote or wait
description: Every weekday morning it assembles a short macro read-out: what the Fed and markets are doing according to X news, with prediction-market FOMC odds folded in as a sentiment gauge. Then it turns to your own timeline and advises whether to quote something, write a fresh post, or sit this one out.
author: 0xashrk
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
